title: Accelerating tasks inside silos leaves operational contradictions intact
text: Giving each department an AI assistant speeds up local tasks while leaving inter-departmental contradictions intact—such as sales quoting delivery dates that purchasing cannot meet due to supplier delays. Genuine workflow redesign requires comparing real-world execution with the planning assumptions used to make commitments across departmental boundaries.
qualification: Practitioner illustrative scenario, not a measured empirical case study.

public_locator.value: A fast response to a late delivery matters less if sales is still promising a date that purchasing cannot meet. Giving each department an assistant can speed up several tasks while leaving that contradiction intact.
